pitch.heading: Coming home to Wrayford
pitch.text: Three years you have been on the far side of the fells, hiring out with the droves. Your mother's letter took a week to find you: your father went out on the road with the cart, it said, and did not come home. Now you are coming down the drove road to Wrayford, the bridge-city on the Wray, on an August morning, a week late.
